categories.label: Hero Images
categories.description: Primary hero banner images for homepage and service pages.
categories.lighting: Warm natural light, 5500K-6000K. Side or three-quarter front.
categories.notes: Must leave space on one side for text overlay. No text baked into the image.

categories.label: Team Photos
categories.description: Individual and group photos of technicians and office staff.
subjects: group team photo by truck or shop
categories.lighting: Even, natural. Outdoors preferred for group shots. Neutral background for headshots.
categories.notes: Clean uniforms. Name badges visible when possible. Real employees, not stock.

categories.label: Equipment and Systems
categories.description: Photos of HVAC units, installations, and components.
categories.lighting: Clean and well-lit. No dark basements. Show equipment in best light.
categories.notes: Equipment should look clean and professional. Include both residential and light commercial if applicable.

categories.label: Completed Work
categories.lighting: Bright, natural. Show the quality of the finished work.
categories.notes: Pair before/after when possible. Clean work area in the after photo.

categories.label: Service Vehicles
categories.description: Company trucks and vans with visible branding.
categories.lighting: Daylight, clean background. No clutter behind vehicles.
categories.notes: Trucks should be clean. Branding and phone number visible. Reinforces legitimacy.

categories.label: Office and Showroom
categories.description: Storefront, reception area, or showroom if applicable.
categories.lighting: Bright interior or clean exterior daylight.
categories.notes: Optional category. Only include if the client has a physical location they want shown.

deliveryFormat: All images delivered as optimized WebP with JPEG fallback. Originals retained at full resolution.
